annotations.failure_error: ImportError: jit_init_thread_state(): the LLVM backend is inactive because the LLVM shared library ("libLLVM.so") could not be found! Set the DRJIT_LIBLLVM_PATH environment variable to specify its path.
annotations.notes: The host's pre-existing venv exactly as found. All five cpu cells fail at import: Rocky Linux 9 ships /lib64/libLLVM.so.20.1 but no unversioned libLLVM.so, the name drjit dlopens. sionna/rt/__init__.py tries cuda_ad_mono_polarized first and only then llvm_ad_mono_polarized, so without the harness's CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' this host would have run 'CPU' on the GPU. Produced before the stderr_tail fix, so the recorded tail is GNU time -v output; the ImportError is preserved in annotations.failure_error.
